description:
The siren is on — the ambulance is racing to Paw Hospital! You are the doctor of the town's little animal hospital.

Every patient arrives with a story: a kitten got tangled in balloons, a puppy stepped on thorns, a bunny ate too many carrots, a penguin slipped on the ice, a parrot lost its voice… Find the patient, carry it to the ambulance and make it all better at the hospital!

RESCUE MISSIONS
10 regions to explore: Town, Forest, Farm, Arctic, Ocean, Savanna, Mountain, Swamp, Desert and Rainforest. Find the hiding patient and lift it onto the stretcher.

17 TREATMENT GAMES
Check the temperature, listen to the heartbeat, find the broken bone with the X-ray, pull out thorns, clean scrapes and add a bandage, wrap a cast, beat the fear of shots with play, give yummy syrup, brush teeth, clean ears and eyes, bubble bath and blow-dry, catch fleas, feed the right food, tuck in for a nap, use an ice pack and snip tangled strings.

500 DIFFERENT LEVELS
Every level is a different animal, a different problem and a different treatment chain. 70 adorable species — cat, dog, bunny, panda, lion, elephant, penguin, dolphin, axolotl and many more — with hurting, relieved and happy faces!

RESCUE GARDEN
Healed animals move into your garden. Pet them, throw a ball, feed them and decorate with swings, a fountain, a rainbow and a treehouse. Some friends find a loving new family and leave you a thank-you card.

PATIENT CARDS & DAILY EMERGENCY
Collect a card for every species and earn treatment stamps. A new golden emergency case every day!

MADE FOR LITTLE HANDS
• No reading needed: a glowing hand shows what to do
• No failing, only gentle feedback
• Plays offline after the first launch
• Purchases and settings are behind a parental gate
• No personal data collected

Seven regions with 350 levels are free. The Arctic, Ocean and Safari packs are optional one-time purchases, and "Unlock Everything" opens all content. Pet Doctor Premium (monthly subscription) unlocks all packs while subscribed.

Subscription: Pet Doctor Premium renews automatically every month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Microsoft account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel at account.microsoft.com/services.

Privacy Policy: https://mucobulut.github.io/oyunlar-destek/petdoctor/privacy/
short: The siren is on! 500 different patients need you: rescue, heal and play in your Rescue Garden.
